Thorough experimental validation with comprehensive ablation studies on hyperparameters (α, β) and consistent improvements across architectures, with ~100k fewer iterations needed for convergence

Critical hyperparameter sensitivity requiring careful tuning of α and β with different optimal values for conditional vs unconditional settings, but limited principled guidance for practitioners beyond grid search

strengths: Unified theoretical framework that elegantly unifies multiple matching models (diffusion, flow, bridge matching, stochastic interpolants) under inverse distillation
Mathematically rigorous treatment with detailed proofs showing how real data can be incorporated via modified UID losses with interpretable coefficients α and β
Addresses practical problem of incorporating real data without requiring GAN losses and additional discriminator networks
Comprehensive theoretical extensions to multiple frameworks (Bridge Matching, Stochastic Interpolants) demonstrating generality of approach

weaknesses: Critically limited experimental validation: only CIFAR-10 at 32×32 resolution with a single GPU; no experiments on larger datasets, higher resolutions, or different domains—insufficient for a top-tier venue in 2024/2025

Insufficient analysis of when real data helps: No characterization of what properties of real data matter, no visualization of how model uses real data, no failure case analysis

strengths: Novel theoretical framework with clean derivations: Theorems 1-2 establish the mathematical foundation; linearization technique elegantly addresses tractability while maintaining rigor
Universal framework applicable to multiple model families: Unified approach to diffusion, flow matching, bridge matching, and stochastic interpolants with extensions provided
Practical solution to real problem: First framework to naturally incorporate real data into distillation without requiring adversarial losses—significant simplification over prior GAN-based methods
Comprehensive experimental analysis: Thorough ablations on α,β coefficients with clear takeaways; convergence analysis showing 3x speedup; proper comparison with baselines
Strong empirical results: RealUID achieves comparable or superior FID to GAN-augmented approaches while maintaining simpler architecture; visual quality results support quantitative metrics
Clear presentation and reproducibility: Well-organized paper with effective figures; detailed experimental protocol; code to be released; implementation details in appendices
weaknesses: Limited experimental scope: Evaluation restricted to CIFAR-10 (32×32); absence of ImageNet, CelebA, or higher-resolution experiments prevents assessment of practical scalability and real-world impact

Incomplete baseline comparisons: Limited comparison with recent distillation methods; only one GAN baseline configuration tested; missing comparisons with other contemporary real-data incorporation approaches
Theoretical approximation validity not thoroughly validated: Linearization approximation is made for tractability but its tightness and empirical impact under various conditions is not analyzed

Computational efficiency claims lack quantitative support: While conceptually simpler than GANs, detailed training-time and memory comparisons are sparse; fine-tuning stage requires careful multi-parameter tuning
Limited guidance for hyperparameter selection: While ablations show α,β impact, principled guidance for selecting these coefficients on new applications/datasets is insufficient
Incremental improvements over baselines: Performance gains, while consistent, are relatively modest; practical significance on only CIFAR-10 raises questions about general impact

strengths: Strong theoretical contribution: Elegant unification of diffusion models, flow matching, bridge matching, and stochastic interpolants under a single UM framework; clever linearization technique (Eq. 10-12) that generalizes well and recovers FGM, SiD, and IBMD as special cases

Practical advantage over GANs: Simpler method without auxiliary discriminators or adversarial losses; avoids GAN instability issues (non-stationary objectives, mode collapse); shows faster convergence (~100k vs ~300k iterations)

Comprehensive experimental evaluation: Extensive ablations on α and β parameters with clear guidance; evaluation on CIFAR-10 and CelebA with both conditional and unconditional settings; reproducible code and detailed hyperparameters provided

Insightful theoretical analysis: Well-motivated connection to inverse optimization (Eq. 15); detailed analysis of why β/α ≠ 1 helps (A.1.3-A.1.4); extensions to General RealUID with multiple degrees of freedom
Thorough presentation: 41-page paper with extensive appendices covering theoretical proofs, alternative formulations, extensions to other frameworks, and detailed experimental protocols
weaknesses: Modest and inconsistent empirical improvements: CIFAR-10 conditional (1.87 vs 1.88 GAN), CelebA (0.89 vs 0.87 GAN) show GAN is competitive or better; improvements often within FID noise margins; requires fine-tuning to achieve best results, undermining simplicity claims

Unfair architecture comparison: Uses lightweight architecture (Tong et al., 2024) with 2× faster inference than EDM-based baselines; makes direct FID comparisons in Tables 3-4 problematic and confounds method with architecture effects

Narrow parameter tuning sweet spot: Optimal β/α must be close to 1 ([0.98, 1.02]); different values needed for training vs fine-tuning; contradicts claim of simplicity since GANs also require careful hyperparameter tuning

Limited experimental scope: Only 32×32 and 64×64 resolutions; no studies on real data amount, teacher quality sensitivity, or non-vision domains; no comparison with alternative non-GAN methods for real data incorporation
Fine-tuning as requirement: Table 2 shows fine-tuning crucial for competitive results; without it, performance gap widens significantly; suggests base method is insufficient for strong performance

Tautological theoretical results: Theorem 1 shows real data generator minimizes the loss with real data (somewhat tautological); analysis of why β/α ≠ 1 helps (A.1.3-A.1.4) relies on hand-wavy distance surface arguments rather than principled derivations

Incomplete exploration of failure modes: Limited discussion of why GAN outperforms on CelebA; DMD extension (A.5) shows problems but receives minimal investigation; unclear when RealUID is preferable vs when GANs remain better

Sound mathematical treatment with well-stated theorems and formal derivations

strengths: Clean theoretical unification of multiple distillation methods (FGM, SiD, IBMD) via linearization technique with rigorous proofs (Theorems 1-2, Lemmas 1-2)
